name: translate
definition: The translate function evaluates a string and a set of characters to translate and returns the translated string.
syntax: translate(string, abc, XYZ)THE QUICK BROWN FOX.The quick red fdx.

functionParameters.description: The string of characters that will be replaced.
The string of characters used for replacement. The first character in XYZ will replace every occurrence of the first character in abc that appears in string.

descriptions: If abc is longer than XYZ, then every occurrence of characters in abc that do not have a corresponding character in XYZ will be removed.
If XYZ contains more characters than abc, the extra characters are ignored.
